title: geranium berteroanum var. ciliatum
intro: Geranium berteroanum var. ciliatum, commonly known as the Chilean geranium, is a plant species belonging to the Geraniaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, promoting wound healing, and exhibiting antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Geranium berteroanum var. ciliatum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, triterpenoids, and phenolic acids, that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. However, more research is needed to confirm the full extent of its benefits and therapeutic actions.
